description: Prepared 14-level global_4deg column at 170E/54S with native Prandtl history and prescribed coefficients.
reference_method: Independent 80-digit matrix exponentials and manual variational chain rules. Unperturbed moments use the carried high-precision state; its float64 projection passes 1e-11 relative/1e-16 absolute accuracy. Negative-ray and mixed-input references use the exact float64 inputs.

native_preparation.description: Native CN/EOS5/shear/transport/funding composition at the accepted conditional mean; derivatives are of conditional equations, not implicit physical control responses.
native_preparation.reference_method: Independent 80-digit CN variational LU solves, archived EOS5 directional derivatives, manual shear/transport/funding derivatives and augmented continuous-event matrix exponentials.

physical_response.description: Self-consistent incoming-energy response in the independently checked actual column.
physical_response.reference_method: Accepted physical points were independently checked using 80-digit event moments, Crank-Nicolson solves, actual-pressure energy integrals, source ownership and equation-of-state work. The local implicit response combines independently checked preparation and event derivatives with an incoming-energy variation. Original direct/adjoint, moment, work and energy criteria are retained.

energy_response.reference_method: Finite values use independently checked 80-digit actual-pressure energy integrals at the physical column endpoints. Variations differentiate density under the pressure integral, independently of native enthalpy-derivative formulas. The energy variation budget uses the declared energy recovery ceiling; the mixing-work precision criterion remains 0.01 J.

zero_start.description: Actual98E/2Scolumn from exactly zero incoming TKE and source history,with finite captured EKE power.
zero_start.reference_method: Saved full native-law DOP853/RK45 moments and independent 80-digit prepared-parameter minimum-length error bounds, Crank-Nicolson solves, actual-pressure energy and mixing-work integrals. Forward moments only; no startup derivative or later-history claim.

half_step_certificate.reference_method: Independent 80-digit equilibrium and minimum-length envelope at the converged first-half means. This source-limited point tests rounding in the subtraction of supplied and consumed power.
